answers.core: For this to be performant and not a nightmare to implement, it couldn't be done as an add-on.
answers.workaround:
As far as I know this would be a nightmare to work around, you would have to do the following:

1. Calculate the positions of newlines in the RichTextLabel
2. Insert those newlines into the raw text (could hypothetically be done ahead of time, but would be a nightmare with translations)
3. Add each character with their effect to the RichTextLabel one at a time for it to display properly

I don't know if Godot even has the functionality to tell you where newlines are in a RichTextLabel built in.

title: Enable RichTextEffects being applied to characters only once displayed
